name: icelandic-grammar-mcp
description: Unofficial MCP server for Miðeind's Málfríður Icelandic grammar and spelling API.
long_description: An unofficial MCP server that gives Claude a check_icelandic_grammar tool, powered by Miðeind's Málfríður proofreading API. Claude can check Icelandic text and apply the returned corrections and suggestions. Requires an API key from a Frjáls áskrift subscription at api.greynir.is. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Miðeind ehf.

tools.name: check_icelandic_grammar
tools.description: Check Icelandic text for spelling and grammar errors; returns corrections and annotated suggestions.

api_key.title: Málfríður API Key
api_key.description: API key from your Frjáls áskrift subscription at api.greynir.is.
